entry.title: New: Resolution 634 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH HAWAIIAN TELCOM, INC. FOR CENTREX BIZ PLUS SERVICE FOR THE HAWAIʻI POLICE DEPARTMENT AND HAWAIʻI FIRE DEPARTMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year agreement at an estimated cost of $22,875 for the Police Department and $11,730 for the Fire Department, for the new joint communications center located at 540 Kupuna Place.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 634-24 & FC-202 - 10/16/2024
